introduction: A journey through memory and emotion, expressed in sculptural texture, shifting color, and metallic light.

artworks.title: Carnations

image.alt: Pink, ivory, green, and gold curls carved into a richly textured surface.

images.alt: Pink, ivory, green, and gold curls carved into a richly textured surface.
Close detail of carnations: raised paint contours and surface texture.
images.sourceFile: VPA Website Update/The Regal Collection/Carnations (Close Up).jpg

description: Pink, green, ivory, and gold gather in flowing, sculpted forms. Curving ridges give the surface a floral rhythm, bringing softness and strength into the same composition.

For the artist, carnations symbolize deep affection and commitment. This painting is a reminder to find joy in one’s actions and encounters, and to recognize that love can also be found within oneself.
artworks.medium: Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas.

artworks.title: Navy

image.alt: Sweeping navy and teal ridges with gold and ivory highlights.

images.alt: Sweeping navy and teal ridges with gold and ivory highlights.
Close detail of navy: raised paint contours and surface texture.
images.sourceFile: VPA Website Update/The Regal Collection/Navy (Close Up).jpg

description: Long ridges sweep through deep navy, teal, ivory, and gold. Their changing direction gives the surface a current of movement, with light catching the raised edges.

Navy is a tribute to the power of water: its capacity to sustain life and its potential to overwhelm. The work asks us to consider our relationship with something both essential and deserving of respect.
artworks.medium: Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas.

artworks.title: Sahara

image.alt: Diagonal gold, ivory, and dark blue marks across a textured canvas.

images.alt: Diagonal gold, ivory, and dark blue marks across a textured canvas.
Close detail of sahara: raised paint contours and surface texture.
images.sourceFile: VPA Website Update/The Regal Collection/Sahara Close (Up).jpg

description: Gold and ivory move diagonally through dark passages, building a surface that feels layered and weathered. Small scattered marks interrupt the longer strokes.

Sahara draws on the artist’s fascination with the desert, its mysteries, and the traces of a world transformed. The painting holds a reminder that landscapes change, while their surfaces continue to carry stories.
artworks.medium: Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas.

artworks.title: Verdant

image.alt: Dense green and gold sculpted curls flowing across the surface.

images.alt: Dense green and gold sculpted curls flowing across the surface.
Close detail of verdant: raised paint contours and surface texture.
images.sourceFile: VPA Website Update/The Regal Collection/Verdant (Close Up).jpg

description: Deep greens and metallic gold weave through an intricate field of sculpted curls. Raised contours catch the light like glimpses through a canopy.

Verdant returns to childhood summer evenings in the woods behind the artist’s home. A hidden fire pit beneath the trees became a place to imagine distant travel, as golden light filtered through the leaves.
artworks.medium: Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas.

artworks.title: Ciaran

image.alt: Ornamental green, pink, ivory, and gold forms in sculpted relief.

images.alt: Ornamental green, pink, ivory, and gold forms in sculpted relief.
Close detail of ciaran: raised paint contours and surface texture.
images.sourceFile: VPA Website Update/The Regal Collection/Ciaran (Close Up).jpg

description: Green, pink, ivory, and gold move through ornamental curves, their raised contours giving the painting a sense of layered movement.
Ciaran is an homage to honor, integrity, and leadership. For the artist, nobility is a quality within everyone: something revealed under pressure and recognized in the people we choose to follow.
artworks.medium: Mixed media acrylic painting with organic plaster base layer on gallery wrapped canvas.
